title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature of the mixture must be correctly calculated as T = 48.57°C.

title: Heat of Fusion
description: Important Criteria: The heat of fusion of ice must be correctly applied in the energy balance equation.

title: Mass Values
description: Important Criteria: The masses of ice and water must be correctly identified and used in calculations.

title: Energy Balance Equation
description: Important Criteria: The energy balance equation must be correctly set up to relate heat lost and gained.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations, ensuring clarity in the energy balance.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include sign mistakes in the energy balance or incorrect application of the heat of fusion.
